title: Kinetic column handoff: jitter-free virtualization + inline filter combobox for sparse tables
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: Our virtualized table currently has visible jitter and layout shifts when users resize columns or open per-column filter controls while the row virtualization window moves. This is most noticeable on sparse datasets (many empty cells) and on high-latency input devices (remote desktops). It hurts perceived performance and causes accessibility issues for keyboard users who rely on focus stability.

Goal: Deliver a new interaction model and component implementation that: (1) eliminates jitter during column resizes and when toggling inline filter UI while virtualization is active, (2) surfaces a compact inline filter combobox that supports multi-select and chipification without rerender thrash, and (3) preserves keyboard focus and screen-reader semantics across virtualization handoffs and density mode changes.

Scope: Design token updates, visual specs for combobox + chips, new resize affordance (kinetic drag + live ghost preview), focus + aria patterns, and handoff strategy with the runtime (ENG) to coordinate virtualization buffer and resize events. Implementation will be coordinated with ENG runtime improvements (ENG-78234) to introduce a short stabilization window that prevents redraws for critical layout changes.

Constraints & considerations:
- Must work in all density modes (compact / default / comfortable).
- Should be friendly to both mouse and keyboard-first flows.
- Aim to avoid additional DOM nodes per cell where possible (use position: absolute layer for previews).
- Prefer pure CSS animations and minimal JS where latency-sensitive.
- Accessibility: focusable filter combobox, proper aria-expanded/aria-controls, live-region announcements for column reorder/resize completion.

Out of scope for this ticket: server-side pagination, new filtering language or backend APIs; those will be tracked in PM backlog if needed.
acceptance_criteria: No visible jitter or column header reflow when resizing while virtualization window shifts (manual QA and automated visual diff).
Inline filter combobox can be toggled without full table rerender and supports typing, keyboard selection, and chipification of up to 10 active filters.
Resize interaction provides a translucent 'ghost' column width preview followed by a single commit step that updates column layout; preview disabled on low-power mode.
Accessibility: keyboard users can open filter combobox with Enter/Space, tab into filter items, and close without losing header focus; screen reader announces 'Filter opened on column X'.
Performance: p99 interaction latency (drag or key open) stays under 40ms on our 95th percentile test fleet; CPU syscalls during resize < 6ms per frame on target machines.
Unit/storybook stories for all density modes and with 0/10/1000 rows demonstrating stability for sparse datasets.
Design tokens updated for combobox/chip spacing and added to tokens-v2 registry with backwards-compatible names.
Implementation PR with runtime coordination notes and one integration test validating virtualization handoff behavior.
engineering_notes: Coordinate with runtime team: introduce a 120ms 'stabilization window' when a header control opens to prevent virtualization rebinds (ENG-78234).
Use an overlay layer for ghost preview (absolutely positioned) to avoid invalidating cell layout; only commit final width once drag completes or on debounced stop (100ms).
For sparse datasets, ensure cell measurement fallbacks — reuse cached widths from previous viewport to avoid heavy measure passes.
Provide a feature flag to disable ghost preview for low-memory / low-power clients.
Add telemetry events: column_resize_start/preview/commit, filter_open/commit/cancel with timings and device hints.
Follow storybook-first approach: team should submit stories before integration PR to make review easier.
rollout_plan: Design review -> engineering spike (2 days) to validate stabilization window -> component prototype in stories -> accessibility audit -> implementation PR -> staged rollout (alpha on 10% of web clients) -> monitor telemetry for jitter and interaction latency -> full release.
Target release in ui-lib-2.8.0 with a follow-up observation window of 2 weeks.
If post-rollout jitter > 1% of interactions, rollback option to disable ghost preview via feature flag.
